name: Home, Sweet UNIT 404
source:
Finally, your own new and carefree life. No restrictions, no scoldings. No annoying people anymore. You can arrange the life of your dreams in a modern apartment with a nice landlord, affordable rent, and a cozy interior. Well, that's until the apartment starts showing its true colors...

[From [url=https://aclypse-ace.itch.io/home-sweet-unit-404]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于有了属于自己的新生活，无忧无虑。没人管，没人骂，身边再也没有那些烦人的家伙。房东人好，租金实惠，装修温馨，你可以在这间现代公寓里把生活布置成梦想中的模样。嗯，直到这间公寓开始露出真面目…
